instruction: Candid outdoor photograph, full shot at eye-level. In a wooded park, the man in the blue short-sleeved shirt (R1) and the woman in the grey blazer (R2) walk side-by-side on a dirt path. The man (R1) on the left looks toward the woman with a warm smile, while the woman (R2) on the right looks back at him, talking. Her right arm is linked through his left arm, and their hands are clasped together. Soft natural daylight filters through the background trees.
